carrier_definition.space: translation orbit tau -> zeta(.+i tau) in compact-open topology on compact K in 1/2<Re(s)<1

theorem_statement: For admissible compact K and nonvanishing holomorphic f, good translates approximating f within epsilon have positive lower density.
RH_relationship: Universality is proved unconditionally and is not equivalent to RH.
retained_nogos: Dichotomy coverage is not refuted because Bagchi is outside the RH-closure carrier scope.
